companion._doc: Companion mode (companion/, MASTER_STATUS #21): chat when bored, the daily brief, small lessons, warm replies to distress. enabled = the whole feature. moneyNotes = the gentle spending note in the day brief (the user can switch it by voice: 'stop the spending notes'; asking 'how am I doing with money' is always answered). chatIdleMs = how long a chat stays on with no turn. brief.messageHours = how far back 'new messages' looks.

helpline._doc: TODO(owner): put a VERIFIED Ghana mental-health helpline here (digits only) and its name. Left empty on purpose: no number is invented. When set, the crisis reply adds 'You can also call <name> on <number>'.
